videos.title: Teleshopping
videos.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

videos.title: Guy's Grocery Games
videos.description: Four previous winners return for the holidays to take on more of Guy Fieri's games; chefs must shop for ingredients using nothing but oversized stockings; chefs are given a gingerbread house that they must flip into a fine dining holiday dinner.

videos.title: Guy's Grocery Games
videos.description: The series' most beloved judges compete against each other using not-so-nice ingredients from Guy's naughty list.

videos.title: The Hairy Bikers Home for Christmas
videos.description: With special guest the Reverend Kate Bottley, the Bikers cook up a cherry-and-bourbon-glazed gammon, rolled and stuffed turkey breast and legs plus a magnificent Christmas croquembouche, as they get to know how Kate spends her Christmas.

videos.title: The Hairy Bikers Home for Christmas
videos.description: The Bikers have the solution to those days between Christmas and New Year with a bang bang turkey salad, figs stuffed with stilton and a chestnut and chocolate roulade. Plus, they find out how special guest Alex Jones spends her Christmas.

videos.title: The Hairy Bikers Home for Christmas
videos.description: The Bikers share some meat-free recipes for when everyone's had enough turkey. They make sage and spinach gnocchi, nut roast with all the trimmings and a hazelnut and pear cake as they find out how special guest Paul Martin spends his Christmas.

videos.title: The Hairy Bikers Home for Christmas
videos.description: The Bikers have the solution for celebration dishes to keep guests happy and get the party started, with a trio of canapes, porchetta pork loin and a prawn and salmon terrine. Plus, they find out how special guest Denise Lewis spends her Christmas.

videos.title: The Hairy Bikers Home for Christmas
videos.description: The Bikers create a turkey jambalaya, a spicy lamb shank and a madeira cake with a chocolate, chilli and ginger fondue as they find out how special guest Nicki Chapman spends her Christmas. Plus, the Bikers make homemade edible Christmas presents.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver: Together
videos.description: Jamie creates a sensational alternative to the traditional Christmas Dinner, featuring an epic mixed roast, an impressive veggie crown and a toffee panettone dessert.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver: Together
videos.description: Jamie gets the festivities started with a sublime Christmas party menu of bramble cocktails, a stunning beef bourguignon, and a sparkling winter bombe ice cream dessert.

videos.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking Christmas
videos.description: Nigel Slater reveals fantastic festive recipes, including a sumptuous casserole, that will warm cockles and fill hungry stomachs throughout the Christmas period.

videos.title: Guy's Big Bite
videos.description: Pork rib eye; bacon-blessed brussels sprouts.

videos.title: Guy's Big Bite
videos.description: Delicious culinary series that's bursting with big flavours. Guy makes a roasted acorn squash soup topped with yogurt and pistachio Parmesan crostini that tastes even better than it looks.

videos.title: Holiday Baking Championship
videos.description: Jesse Palmer asks the bakers to turn steakhouse desserts into decadent holiday treats. The competitors impress the judges by transforming a traditional steakhouse icon into a tasty Christmas tree.

videos.title: Buddy vs. Christmas
videos.description: Buddy Valastro takes on America's greatest non-cake artists in a series of Christmas-themed challenges. It's cake vs mixed media art in an epic yuletide battle!

videos.title: Holiday Wars
videos.description: Host Raven-Symone challenges the four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists to imagine the most romantic wedding the world has ever seen at the North Pole! Judges Shinmin Li and Erin Acevedo decide which team will go home with $25,000.

videos.description: For the signature challenge, the bakers are instructed to make 24 sandwich biscuits. The technical challenge requires the bakers to make fortune cookies. In the final showstopper challenge, the bakers are required to make a biscuit board game.

videos.title: The Great British Bake Off
